jars: The phrase 'turning on itself the moment the day ended' (Insight) is a bit clinical and abstract for a tired mom.
'All-devouring and greatly harmful' (Day 2) sounds a bit like a generic sermon or a health warning label, slightly out of register with the app's usual tone.
'Take up real cheerfulness' (Day 6) feels like a slightly patronizing command to a woman who is already struggling to regulate her emotions.
best: When your child runs from dinner, you can meet their eyes with steadiness instead of the storm you carry home. The grandest thing about them is the ordinary hours. Just be little with them, and let yourself be little too.
day1_verdict: It gets me—the idea that the spilled milk wasn't the trigger, but the blocked wanting from my day at the practice, which actually explains why I'm so calm at work but lose it at home.
